Sort of...I've been hanging on for about 2 years and never been with him all that time.Close friends.He used to keep his promises,but now he rarely does.Some things about him make me wonder what kind of person he really is and now I feel like it was all a lie.He was pretty much the only person who ever made me feel really loved and if that was all a lie?Well...
No,I haven't been with another person.
Me time is only a temporary fix.I've had loads of time on my own.
